items.zh_oneliner: 成人玩具需求持续增长，卖家选品可关注面向成年消费者的玩具与收藏品类。
items.en_oneliner: Adult demand for toys keeps growing, so sellers should watch toys and collectibles aimed at grown-up buyers.

items.title: 2026 Holiday Shipping Deadlines: USPS, UPS & FedEx Cutoffs for eCommerce Sellers
items.zh_title: 2026 假日季快递截止日期：USPS、UPS 与 FedEx 截单时间一览
items.zh_oneliner: Ordoro 汇总三大快递商的假日截单日期，跨境卖家可据此安排黑五与圣诞季的发货节奏。
items.en_oneliner: Ordoro rounds up the holiday shipping cutoffs for the three major carriers, helping cross-border sellers plan Black Friday and Christmas dispatch.

items.title: JPMorgan cards chief to depart
items.zh_title: 摩根大通信用卡业务主管将离任
items.zh_oneliner: 摩根大通信用卡业务主管即将离任，卡组织与支付格局或有后续变化，卖家可留意动向。
items.en_oneliner: JPMorgan's cards chief is departing, which could shift the card and payments landscape — sellers should watch for follow-on moves.

items.title: OpenAI wallet taps card networks
items.zh_title: OpenAI 钱包接入卡组织网络
items.zh_oneliner: OpenAI 钱包与卡组织合作，钱包支付可能成为新的电商结账入口，卖家值得关注。
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI's wallet is partnering with card networks, and wallet payments could become a new ecommerce checkout entry point for sellers to watch.

items.title: black rifle coffee
items.zh_title: Black Rifle Coffee 关闭 12 家直营门店
items.zh_oneliner: 美国咖啡连锁品牌 Black Rifle Coffee 宣布关闭 12 家直营门店，登上热搜。
items.en_oneliner: US coffee chain Black Rifle Coffee is closing 12 company-owned stores, a move that hit the trending searches.
